authoring.rule: This manifest is the expected universe. Generator output must be reconciled against it: generate.py --check fails on a GUI item or scripting candidate that exists on one side only, and on any status or guiKey that disagrees.
authoring.firstGenerationCaveat: The first version of this manifest and the first generated catalog were authored in the same session, so the initial cross-check mainly proves internal consistency. Its drift value applies to every later change: a PowerPoint upgrade that alters an enumeration, or a generator change that re-dispositions a value, fails --check until this file is updated deliberately.
